column1: 14 data products. ACE is the system of record for seven, ingested from the source named; the Workbench is the system of record for the other seven. Each has one way in and one freshness. The 14 hold 97 of the 122 entities; OPS, AGT and RPT hold the other 25.

column3: Loan accounts with balances, interest, fees, days past due, bucket, classification, restructure flag and payments
column5: Read through recovery.v_ace_account, v_ace_payment, v_ace_aa_relation and v_ace_bucket_log. ACE ingests ALS daily; the Workbench loads nothing.
column6: ACE end of day; the views carry the ACE business date
column9: Case owner, restructuring officer, write-off team member

column3: Customers, guarantors, co-borrowers and heirs, identity masked to the last four, contact points, consent and flags for vulnerability, death and bankruptcy
column4: ACE (ingested from SCBPDM and the core bank)
column5: Read through recovery.v_ace_customer, v_ace_contact, v_ace_ca_relation and v_ace_party_product. The Workbench holds only its own flags and consent in party_ext and contact_point_ext.
column6: ACE end of day; consent and flags as they change in the Workbench
column7: Yes: customer profile; party_product added by RWB-ACE-001
column9: Case owner, hardship and vulnerability specialist, Compliance and PDPA officer

column3: The case, its accounts and parties, status, stage, route, owner, queue, tasks, timers and deviations
column5: Held in the Workbench. Accounts and parties are linked by ACE business key to v_ace_account and v_ace_customer; no foreign key.
column9: Case owner, team manager, capacity and workforce planner

column3: Restructures, settlements, deeds in lieu, buy-backs and guarantee claims, with terms, approval level and outcome
column4: Recovery Workbench for the treatment; ACE (ingested from the core bank) for the restructure plan
column5: Held in the Workbench; the plan reference, status and published calculation are read through recovery.v_ace_plan, and the credit result through v_ace_credit_decision.
column6: As it changes in the Workbench; plan status from the ACE batch
column7: Partly: restructure calculation; credit_decision added by RWB-ACE-001

column3: Every contact, letter, promise and hand-over on the case, in order, including the collections history from EFS
column5: Read through recovery.v_ace_efs_action and v_ace_efs_assignment. The Workbench writes its own contact, letter and promise entries to interaction.
column6: ACE end of day; Workbench entries as they change
column9: Case owner, phone and field collector, Conduct and QA officer

column3: Collateral, appraisals, assets held after repossession or transfer, listings and sale results
column4: ACE (ingested from CCMS, SVAF, AMIS and RPS)
column5: Read through recovery.v_ace_collateral, v_ace_collateral_detail, v_ace_asset, v_ace_npa_asset, v_ace_npa_sale and v_ace_valuation. Listings and sale results stay in the Workbench.
column6: ACE weekly or monthly per source; listings as they change
column7: Yes after RWB-ACE-001: collateral_detail, valuation, npa_asset and npa_sale are Tier 2
column9: NPA and asset manager, sale officer, Head of NPA

column3: Notices and proof of delivery, lawsuits, court case numbers, hearings, judgments and enforcement
column4: ACE (ingested from LIT and WIN) for the court record and the proof of delivery; Workbench for notices and enforcement
column5: Read through recovery.v_ace_lawsuit, v_ace_hearing and v_ace_pod. Notices and enforcement actions are written to the Workbench and dispatched through WIN.
column6: ACE end of day; Workbench entries as they change
column7: Partly: litigation status; lawsuit, hearing and pod_receipt added by RWB-ACE-001
column9: Litigation officer, enforcement owner, law firm user

column3: Partners on the panel, work placed with each, results, fees and scorecards
column5: Held in the Workbench; partner results arrive through the partner portal.
column9: Partner and agency manager, Head of Litigation

column3: Debt sale lots, the accounts in each lot, buyers, prices, approval and put-backs
column5: Held in the Workbench. Past lots are migrated once from the bank's debt sale files; nothing is loaded at run time.
column7: No: debt sale data not in ACE
column9: Debt sale officer, Head of Asset Liquidity

column3: Documents against the case, the fields read from them, retention class and custody of originals
column5: Held in the Workbench. The signature request and its status are read through recovery.v_ace_esign.
column7: New in the Workbench; esign_request added by RWB-ACE-001
column9: Case owner, Credit Administration officer, Legal counsel

column3: Risk scores, expected return by route, estimated sale price and sale success rate, restructure scheme suggestions
column5: Read through recovery.v_ace_score. The Workbench loads nothing.
column6: ACE end of day; monthly for some models
column7: Yes: COLLINS scores; collins_score added by RWB-ACE-001 if ACE does not hold the model
column9: Case owner, Risk and model risk officer, center of excellence analyst

column3: One entry per decision with the rule, model and agent versions, inputs, recommendation, approval, actions and outcome
column9: Internal audit, Risk and model risk officer, center of excellence analyst

column3: Payments and proceeds matched to the case, write-off postings and recovery after charge-off
column5: Read through recovery.v_ace_payment and v_ace_write_off; proceeds matching and the write-off decision stay in the Workbench.
column6: ACE end of day for payments; monthly for GL
column7: Partly: payments; gl_write_off added by RWB-ACE-001
column9: Write-off team member, Finance and CFO delegate

column3: Rules, approval limits, lists of values, roles, permissions and letter templates, each versioned
column5: Held in the Workbench and versioned. Source codes and descriptions are read through v_ace_product, v_ace_branch, v_ace_efs_action_code, v_ace_holiday and v_ace_iam_group rather than loaded.
column7: New in the Workbench; lists confirmed against ACE views
column9: Reference data administrator, data steward and data product owner
